description: Ministry of Labour- Industrial Disputes between D.N.A. Jayamaha and The Institution of Engineers, Sri Lanka- Industrial Dispute between H.V. Jayarathne and  Sri Lanka Transport Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of statutory powers under the Industrial Disputes Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It contains legal orders issued under specific legislation, references to statutory instruments and amendments, and formal legal procedures for dispute resolution - all characteristic of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes. While it mentions a minister (Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando), this is incidental to the legal/regulatory function being performed under established legislation.
